what_it_does: Distributed storage systems use erasure coding (a technique that spreads data redundantly across servers) so that if one server fails, data can be reconstructed. Repair traffic (the network messages to rebuild the missing data) competes with normal read/write requests over shared network bandwidth, slowing repair and hurting performance. ChameleonEC divides repair into fine-grained tasks, routes them through network paths avoiding congestion, and dynamically reschedules around slow servers to minimize interference with foreground user traffic on cloud infrastructure like Amazon EC2.
